# Evidence example index

The five fictional supporting records and the missing-artifact, moving-reference, and skipped-mandatory-check decision drills are maintained in [Acceptance and evidence](../../standards/acceptance-evidence.md#fictional-examples-with-supporting-records). That standard keeps the records complete in one place so copies cannot drift or omit fields.

All outcomes there are explicitly illustrative; actual execution is N/A unless a real command and evidence record are supplied. The examples do not establish program acceptance or change the integration-evals master tracker.
